key_figures.question: Q1
key_figures.role: show deterministic pipeline and ML transfer failure including suspicious overlap case
key_figures.cannot_prove: independent generalization if source duplicates cross splits

key_figures.question: Q2
key_figures.role: show fragment repair and fixed-period fit
key_figures.cannot_prove: validity of poor/high-missingness fits without reject criteria

key_figures.question: Q3
key_figures.role: show numerical stability and sampling sensitivity

key_figures.question: Q4
key_figures.role: show scenario sensitivity and placement narrative

recommended_figure_rules: mark source-group split/duplicates on learned-model comparisons
period-fit figures include residual, missingness and reject state
sampling plots label dense result numerical reference unless external truth
Monte-Carlo probability figures show calibration target or use score terminology
